organization.name_ja: 株式会社イエローハット

affected.note: Maximum number of Yellow Hat members whose data may have leaked, as announced on 2026-08-28. Yellow Hat said passwords, credit card and vehicle data were not held in the system. This is separate from the April 2026 incident at subsidiary 2rinkan Yellow Hat.

summary.en: Yellow Hat detected an attack by a malicious program on its online service reservation system on the morning of 2026-08-18 and cut its external connections. It announced that names, phone numbers, email addresses and member numbers of up to 1,801,499 members may have leaked.
summary.ja: イエローハットは、2026年8月18日朝に「イエローハットWEB作業予約システム」への不正プログラムによる攻撃を検知し、外部接続を遮断した。最大1,801,499名の会員の氏名、電話番号、メールアドレス、会員番号が漏えいした可能性があると発表した。
